nodes.question: How do investments in employees' skills and development enhance trust with retailers in the sustainable fashion industry?
nodes.answer: Investing in employees' skills and development not only enhances knowledge sharing within the company but also builds trust with retailers who value a well-trained and knowledgeable design team.
